capability.name: What changed in an MCP server's tools since the set you approved
capability.description: Give the server and the set you approved (its MTL/1 digest, or the tools array). From HISTOR's daily reads: unchanged (since when), or every change since the server last served your set — tools added, removed and modified with the fields that moved — and what the tool list costs a model in tokens now against then. HISTOR's own signed answer comes back with it.

note: the 'did it change since I approved it' check, with token growth
